abilities.name: Temporal Strike
abilities.description: A swift thrust from the Crystalline Chronometer. 10% chance to inflict Slow.

abilities.name: Hourglass Barrier
abilities.description: Encases an ally in a 1-second time-loop, granting +25% Evasion for 1 turn.

abilities.name: Shattered Second
abilities.description: Chloe shatters her blade into a thousand shards, striking all enemies for 3x damage and reducing their SPD by 20%.

passive.name: Chronos Resonance
passive.effect: +15% Physical Evasion. Successful dodges grant a stackable +5% SPD buff (Max 3 stacks).

lore_snippet: An enigmatic traveler from another world, pulled into Aethelgard through a temporal anomaly. She wields time-bending arts from her home and seeks to understand the Shattered Nexus to forge her own path.
